# Autoimmune Support Club (AISC)

> A global, community-driven emotional support group for people living with autoimmune diseases and chronic illnesses. Join a quiet place where you are seen, heard, and held.

## Key Pages
- [Home](/): The main entry point to the Autoimmune Support Club community.
- [About Us](/about): Learn about our mission, vision, and the foundation of our community.
- [Our Team](/team): Meet the compassionate individuals behind AISC.
- [Blog](/blog): Read stories, advice, and updates from our community members and experts.
- [Whitepapers](/whitepapers): Deep dives and research regarding autoimmune diseases and our community impact.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach out to us for support, partnerships, or to join the club.
